source.license_note: The repository explicitly distinguishes Apache-2.0 code and CC-BY-NC-4.0 data. This processed dataset is a noncommercial academic derivative of the data; it is not relicensed as Apache-2.0.
source.citation: Li, X., Zhang, T., Dubois, Y., Taori, R., Gulrajani, I., Guestrin, C., Liang, P., and Hashimoto, T. B. (2023). AlpacaEval: An Automatic Evaluator of Instruction-following Models. GitHub repository.

curation.selection: All exactly matched prompt groups surviving fixed filters; no response quality or classification result used in selection.
curation.source_exclusion: All OASST prompts excluded as a conservative curation choice for user-contributed conversations. All Koala prompts excluded from every split to honor the source README request against training use.
curation.privacy_note: Conservative pattern screening applied to prompts and all three outputs; matching one text excludes all three answers. This is screening, not an assertion that the removed benchmark examples contain real identities.
curation.empty_filter: Exclude a whole matched prompt when any provider answer is blank.
curation.identity_scrub: Case-insensitive model/provider identity substrings replaced with the shared literal [MODEL] in both prompt and response; raw answers preserved only in ignored download cache. Original text hashes retained for traceability.
curation.domain_method: Fixed ordered keyword regex rules applied to the original prompt only: programming, mathematics, science, writing, else general. Heuristic task tags, not expert annotations.
curation.split_key: split_group_id (all responses to the same and near-duplicate prompts travel together)
curation.group_rule: Word tokens >=8, length ratio >=0.60, character SequenceMatcher >=0.85 OR word-trigram Jaccard >=0.80; connected components.
curation.source_dataset_meaning: Original benchmark collection identity; a holdout by this field measures collection/source generalization rather than a clean topic domain shift.

limitations: One snapshot/model per provider; results do not establish invariance across versions or modern models.
Provider-specific prompt templates, generation dates and decoding behavior can affect style.
Published max output tokens differ: GPT/Claude 4096 versus Gemini 2048.

All input content is identical across classes within each prompt; prompt-only classification therefore has a theoretical 1/3 accuracy ceiling for deterministic classifiers on the balanced matched test set.
Heuristic topic tags can misclassify prompts; original benchmark-source tags are retained separately.
Noncommercial academic use and redistribution must preserve attribution and the CC-BY-NC-4.0 notice.

grouping.rule: Word tokens >=8, length ratio >=0.60, character SequenceMatcher >=0.85 OR word-trigram Jaccard >=0.80; connected components.
